§35.11 Tables

ⓘ
Keywords:
tables, zonal polynomials
Permalink:
http://dlmf.nist.gov/35.11
See also:
Annotations for Ch.35

Tables of zonal polynomials are given in James (1964) for |κ|≤6, Parkhurst and James (1974) for |κ|≤12, and Muirhead (1982, p. 238) for |κ|≤5. Each table expresses the zonal polynomials as linear combinations of monomial symmetric functions.
